intro: Herbal teas for Back pain are a natural remedy that involves steeping herbs in hot water to create a soothing beverage that can help alleviate back pain. These teas work by reducing inflammation, relaxing muscles, and improving circulation, providing relief from chronic pain and discomfort. By incorporating these herbal teas into one's daily routine, individuals can experience a natural and holistic approach to managing back pain.
